basis: current GitHub main and Drone machine state
director_findings: The independent review correctly corrected the B13 planning blind spot: earlier canonical Systems questions Q061-Q071 and Q142-Q169 already cover many Chapter 4 propositions that the plan treated as new.
C002 is retained because the fixed-wing no-lateral-translation/banked-turn rule is not answer-defining in the current canonical bank.

C009 is the only accepted Tier B candidate. It changes aircraft applicability to large multirotor and tests the source-defined broader ground-effect operating envelope rather than generic helicopter ground-effect recognition or helicopter takeoff/landing actions.

C014 is retained because the Ah = current A × time h relationship is a new answer-defining relation. Q159 covers usable-capacity variation with discharge current and temperature but does not define ampere-hour capacity itself.
C020 is retained because proactive antenna orientation from directional radiation/reception characteristics is distinct from Q246's abnormal multipath-recovery action.

C007 is correctly rejected under the core-proposition density policy: Q149 already requires the same clockwise/counter-clockwise reaction-torque balance knowledge and its deliberate imbalance for yaw; isolating the prerequisite balance is insufficient new practice value.
C011 is correctly rejected as a direct collision with Q078, which already tests periodic maintenance triggered by elapsed period or accumulated flight time.
The remaining fourteen rejected candidates are direct or semantic collisions with canonical Q061/Q063/Q068/Q070/Q071/Q142/Q146/Q148/Q149/Q156/Q161/Q162/Q163/Q166.
The 20-candidate ceiling is not a quota. Sixteen rejected candidates are dropped without replacement in B13.
No HUMAN review is claimed or fabricated.
